plugins.name: review-sanity-check
plugins.description: Run a self-review pass over a change before opening a PR: commit hygiene, comment noise, unsafe property access, prop drilling, duplication, and a verified fix-list for any existing review comments.

plugins.name: architecture-guardrails
plugins.description: Record a repo's app-level and module-level guardrails — storage and persistence, token storage, navigation routes, cross-module action contracts, network, platform facades — each with its current value, location, check command and change protocol.

metadata.description: Claude Code skills for pre-PR self-review and for recording a codebase's architecture guardrails.
